messages.subject: Expected distance E(d) interpretation
parts:
Hi all
I would like to know what would be the interpretation of the Expected distance E(d) parameter of the kernel models?
I understand that it is a parameter that allows comparison between different kernel models, but what exactly would that value be showing?
Many thanks
Best regards,

Paula

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Expected distance E(d) interpretation
parts:
I'm not sure what is tripping you up. The expected value is a property of a statistical distribution. In this case it refers to what you might call the average distance moved (when habitat is not constraining). See section 2.7 of Efford & Schofield 2022.
Murray
